newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks extend dive, Dow off three pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks extend dive, Dow off three pct.

text.p: U.S. stocks extended their dive on Thursday, with the Dow industrials off over three percent.
The Dow was down 215 points at 6665. The Nasdaq composite lost 26 points, or two percent, to 1242.
Analysts cited market concern over rising interest rates, and the prospect for competition for stocks from bonds.
The long bond closed off 1-8/32, its yield rising to 7.09 percent. Traders said strong economic data gave rise to concern further interest rate hikes were coming.
